title: Input-Endpoint Compactness and Essential Norms for Weighted Bilinear Hardy Operators
summary: We study compactness of the product of two weighted Hardy primitives into $L^q(u)$, $0<q<\infty$, on the input boundary $1\le p_1,p_2\le\infty$, where at least one input exponent is $1$ or $\infty$. For $L^1\times L^p$, $1<p<\infty$, boundedness implies compactness when $q<p/(p+1)$. For $L^1\times L^1$, the corresponding range is $q<1/2$. At and above these boundaries compactness is characterized by additional active-tail decay, and critical power weights give bounded noncompact examples.
